title: Demonstrating HumanTHOR: A Simulation Platform and Benchmark for Human-Robot Collaboration in a Shared Workspace
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of a simulation platform (HumanTHOR) and benchmarks for human-robot collaboration tasks. While it evaluates 'human trust' in the experiments, this is measured as a behavioral response to robot reliability and efficiency rather than as an evaluation of religious, ethical, or moral systems.
